title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Orientation day on campus.


Very excited in UBC, teachers and classmates are nice!
But a little stressfel about the quiz and grade, but I believe I can get the degree.
What surprised me? I would say the washroom. Public washrooms all have paper, and there are all gender washrooms. And the facilities in the campus are so nice, almost every building has microwave and fridge, Nice!!
